title: C418 Forgotten Tracks
description: This pack adds C418 music tracks that weren't added (including minecraft volume gamma and "Minecraft" by Deadmau5) and removes non C418 tracks
body:
This removes all non C418 tracks (except music discs) and replaces them with C418 music to keep the climate of older versions.
# The tracks added:
Beton
Alpha
Dragonfish
Axolotl
Intro
Shuniji
Minecraft by Deadmau5
Droopy likes your face
Droopy likes ricochet
Equinoxe
Door
Excuse
Ki
Chris
Beginning
